p1: A serial killer once asked the police for advice... and they lied to him.
Between 1974 and 1991, he killed ten people in Wichita, Kansas.
He gave himself a name, and sent letters bragging about it.
Then he went silent. For thirteen years.
This time, he asked the police a question.
Could he send them a floppy disk... without it being traced?
Police answered with an ad in the newspaper.
He believed them. He mailed the disk to a TV station.
Police checked the file. It was last saved by someone named Dennis... at Christ Lutheran Church.
The president of that church council was a husband. A father. A former Cub Scout leader.
One of his victims lived just down the street from him.
His name is Dennis Rader. He called himself BTK.
He got ten life sentences. All because he trusted the police.
